criteria.text:
Prepare Content Factory release excluding active HeyGen work
Prepare a deployable Content Factory release from accepted main, inventory all other refs, and exclude active codex/chat-owner-feedback-20261106 and its dirty HeyGen worktree. Preserve all unrelated work, live data, pinned previews and recovery assets. Fix the existing cold PlanCard fixture preparation without relaxing assertions/timeouts; run the complete configured release verification on one frozen candidate. Prepare reviewed source/image/schema/rollback artifacts and operator commands; do not switch production, apply live schema, make paid calls, connect real accounts or publish social posts.
Acceptance: (1) Git/PR inventory distinguishes merged, patch-equivalent, unproved historical and excluded work with exact identities. (2) The frozen candidate excludes all unique HeyGen work, passes complete release checks and has an honest exact-source suite receipt. (3) Release artifacts, required additive SQL and rollback/owner deployment commands are concrete and verified; deployment itself is excluded. (4) Safe-only cleanup and closeout preserve active/dirty/foreign work and record canonical task state and external boundaries.
